mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, sku_name, price, original_price, unit, stock, sales, is_default, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY is_default DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT sku.id, sku.product_id, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, sku.price, sku.original_price, sku.unit, sku.stock, sku.sales, sku.is_default, sku.sort_order, sku.status, p.status AS product_status, sku.created_at, sku.updated_at FROM product_sku sku INNER JOIN mall_product p ON p.id = sku.product_id WHERE sku.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku sku INNER JOIN mall_product p ON p.id = sku.product_id SET sku.stock = sku.stock - #{quantity}, sku.sales = sku.sales + #{quantity}, sku.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE sku.id = #{id} AND sku.status = 1 AND p.status = 1 AND sku.stock >= #{quantity}
